title: Node r7n2 unreachable — telemetry stopped, SLURM down
summary: Node r7n2 stopped reporting all IPMI telemetry at ~10:45 UTC and SLURM marks it 'down'. Peer nodes r7n0–r7n7 continue reporting normally. The node is unreachable and any jobs on it require rescheduling.
notes: Power-cycle r7n2 via BMC; check IB link and BMC reachability.
